# Hedwig

> Check before your agent pays. Hedwig checks a proposed transaction against your rules and returns reasons. Try the local checker; the Solana demo is in development.

## Pages

- [Hedwig | Check before your agent pays](https://usehedwig.xyz/): Check before your agent pays. Hedwig checks a proposed transaction against your rules and returns reasons. Try the local checker; the Solana demo is in development.
- [About | Hedwig](https://usehedwig.xyz/about): Hedwig helps people check what their payment agent is about to sign. Start with the local checker and follow the Solana demo in development.
- [How it works | Hedwig](https://usehedwig.xyz/how-it-works): Check each proposed action before signing. Try the local checker today; the Solana PayBox demo with a score and original report is in development.
- [Proof | Hedwig](https://usehedwig.xyz/proof): Inspect a recorded Solana devnet run covering an allowed request, an amount over the limit, missing evidence and a revoked role.
- [Roadmap | Hedwig](https://usehedwig.xyz/roadmap): Start with the local checker. Next: a Solana PayBox demo that checks a swap, holds an invalid deposit and explains the original result.
- [Team | Hedwig](https://usehedwig.xyz/team): Hi, I'm Gabe. I'm focused full time on Hedwig.
- [Docs | Hedwig](https://usehedwig.xyz/docs): Connect Hedwig through local MCP, set your policy and inspect a sample payment check. Your application controls signing.
- [Add Hedwig to your agent](https://usehedwig.xyz/agents): Add an eval gate to your payment agent. Install Hedwig v0.4.2 locally, set your rules and run a sample check without sending funds.

## Setup

These guides install v0.4.2. Newer changes on main may use different configuration.

- [Consult Hedwig](https://usehedwig.xyz/agents.md): local setup and owner approval.
- [When to consult Hedwig](https://usehedwig.xyz/agentskill.md): payment checks through MCP.
- [Source](https://github.com/gabchess/hedwig)
